name: Golden Gate Bridge
note: The NEAR level of the bridge (BUGS.md #211). tools/cities.ts's `skyline` entry is the FAR level and stays; Landmarks.update() disables the stand-in once the rider is within 1.3 km of THIS model's own rectangle, so there is one bridge, not two. Position, bearing and baseY are fitted to the ride graph's own west sidewalk (edge 1002983) over the bridge proper, not to the skyline entry's stale lat/lon — centre -5850.7,2929.8 local, axis -5.259 deg, and the model's roadway within +-0.58 m of the ridden path. `coversRaised` suppresses the OSM extruded slab, its generic piers and the `building:part` tower stacks under the same footprint.
